alpha: opaque full-scene PNGs; no transparent cutouts

sprite_contract.reason: Static scene references, no sprite sheet, cell, frame order, or foot pivot.

brightness.high: more enemies attracted; stronger light; enemies in light slightly weaker

limitations: AI paint-overs preserve scene composition but not pixel-identical UI, markers, or soldiers.
Intensity multipliers are design labels, not measured linear-light photometry.
Battle view is perspective; exact aperture is specified by design labels.
Brightness panel visible illumination footprint also changes with falloff; intended aperture is 60 degrees in both.
